mentions.name: AI Hacker
mentions.description: An autonomous AI security agent that reviews code for vulnerabilities, designed to offset the gap between demand for security expertise and its supply, which AI-generated code is accelerating. The author argues "generate secure code by default" is not a near-term solve, so the tool works autonomously to restore the balance.
mentions.problem: Demand for security expertise vastly outpaces supply, and AI-generated code is accelerating this gap; secure code generation by default is unlikely to be solved anytime soon.
mentions.author: fedex_00
